title: Adopting AI Coding Agents: A Practical Plan for Small Teams
description:
Companion article: https://yunjiseo1.substack.com/p/a-small-team-adoption-plan-verify

A small team can start with one bounded task, identify who checks the result, and match controls to risk. This video considers technical judgment, security costs and the distinction between deployment roadmaps and shipped capabilities.

Agent Engineering Brief | Yunji Seo
Assessment as of October 16, 2026.

Sources:
https://github.blog/ai-and-ml/ai-is-rewriting-the-developer-career-ladder-heres-how-to-stand-out/
https://stackoverflow.blog/2026/10/08/production-grade-llms-and-agents-a-field-guide/
https://github.blog/ai-and-ml/github-copilot/secret-protection-must-scale-with-software/
https://blog.cloudflare.com/deno-joins-cloudflare/
https://www.latent.space/p/thariq

Limitations: The evidence relies heavily on provider accounts and practitioner perspectives. It does not establish measured benefits or adoption costs for student teams. Announced plans are distinguished from verified capabilities.

Disclosure: Research and drafting were assisted by AI. Yunji Seo supplied editorial judgments and approved the article/script drafts. Google Vids generated the synthetic narration and presentation; final scene timing was adjusted locally. The abstract background is AI-generated.
